# 325b — R6.53: W4 results re-fold + superseding records

The executed W4 window (`hh-fp-window/1` `2026-11-19-fp-w4-window.json`,
120 settled slots, 0 withheld) is refolded under ADR-0452 into an
evidence-honest record set: a committed outcomes fold, an `answer-scan/1`
sweep, the REQ-XD-071 review handoff, and five superseding packets that
retire the `withheld{window_deadline}:protected_pair_truncated{k<5,R<5}`
basis *only where execution supports claims*. The frozen R6.48 packets
stay append-only — every sidecar re-verifies. **USD $0.00** — offline,
no metered calls.

## What landed

- **`hh-fp-w4-outcomes/1`** — per-slot fold over `slot_results` +
  retained evidence: mini-swe-agent 50×rc=0 / **29 pass** (each
  `collect/reward.txt` cited by sha256); hh_native 46×rc=0 + **4×rc=1
  recorded failures** (never withholds) with all 50 verifier execs
  recorded-failure; v5 20 `verifier_unavailable{env_closed_or_unmounted}`
  + 30 derived `dropped{makespan_checkpoint:w4-round-2}`; Pi/CC
  `not_run{admission:AG3}` verbatim.
- **Five superseding packets** — P2-FP (`not_run{admission:AG3}` packet
  disposition, mini-swe-agent landed `executed` reference, pi/cc
  unavailable members), P4-FP (`unavailable{no_scored_outcome}`), P3-L2
  (`unavailable{h_side_verdicts_absent}`), the L1-on-L2 audit
  (`not_computed` replay leg, seeded W4-O-only sample committed), L3
  (descriptive distributions + uncertain-pair class). Every packet
  carries `supersedes` → the R6.48 frozen record, a `supersession`
  member citing ADR-0452 + the W4 window sha256, and typed markers —
  never fabricated scores.
- **`answer-scan/1` + `hh-flagged-review-input/1`** — 50 scored trials
  scanned: **32 flagged, 16 on passes** → routed to **HUMAN-H19**
  (`pending{human}`; agent-drafted readout
  `docs/build/readouts/HUMAN-H19.md`). The agent never reviews,
  clears or confirms.
- **Freeze veto holds** — `fp_w4_results freeze` refuses all five
  packets verbatim on the unreviewed flags; no `*-frozen` copies
  minted; the `hh-site-publication/1` supersession is deferred by
  design (the site input set points at frozen records; publishing over
  unreviewed flags is exactly what REQ-XH-121 gates).
- **Tooling** — `crates/hh-runner/src/fp_w4.rs` (fold + packets +
  validators; `population::assemble` is the one counting rule —
  unscored slots resolve `OracleFailure`/`Unavailable`, never
  coerced), `bin/fp_w4_results.rs` (`emit` / `emit-packets` /
  `freeze`), `scripts/fp-w4-results-inputs.txt`,
  `scripts/check-fp-w4-results.sh` (25 legs), `tests/r6_53.rs` (9
  tests).
